Ads are set to land on Apple Maps in the US and Canada at some point this summer. Ahead of the official rollout, Apple has shared more details about what can and cannot appear in Apple Maps ads.

Apple Maps ads are coming soon, and the company is simultaneously revealing the prohibited categories.

Apple first announced plans to introduce ads in Apple Maps back in March of this year. The company says ads will appear at the top of search results, as well as in a new "Suggested Places" rail within the app.

Apple laid the groundwork back in May with iOS 26.5, which included the new Suggested Places feature. But the company has not shared any update on when ads will actually launch on Apple Maps since then.

According to TechCrunch, Apple has now updated its Apple Advertising Services policies with new information regarding Apple Maps.

The policies cover the general advertising guidelines across Apple services like News, Stocks, and Maps, and include a lengthy list of content prohibited across all services, including violence, weapons, and drugs.

However, the most notable part is the additional disclosure about Apple Maps advertising. Apple notes that there are three additional categories of ads specifically prohibited on Apple Maps:

  • Home services: Ads that include or directly or indirectly promote home services—including but not limited to plumbing, locksmiths, HVAC repair, pest control, roof repair, or general contractor services—are not permitted.
  • Bail bonds: Ads that include or directly or indirectly promote bail bond services or services related to pretrial release in criminal cases are not permitted.
  • Crypto ATMs: Ads that include or directly or indirectly promote cryptocurrency ATMs are not permitted.

Additionally, Apple says ads related to medical services will be evaluated on a "case-by-case basis."

As TechCrunch points out, Apple's blanket ban on the entire "home services" category is notable. Such ads are a major revenue source on Google Maps, but Apple clearly has no interest in bringing them to Apple Maps.

All signs point to Apple planning to launch ads on Apple Maps imminently. However, there is still no official launch date as of now.

Readers can check out the full list of prohibited ad categories across all Apple services on Apple's website.
